name: core-move-range
description: Rules audit (core, switch TI4_MOVE_CHECK, on by default): LRR 58 MOVEMENT - a ship moves at most its move value (+ the bonuses it has) systems. The original staged any move and printed '(distance exceeds move value ...)'. Now Done moving / the direct move is refused when a ship's distance exceeds its move value plus every move bonus the player could apply (MovementRules.rangeRefusal; effects not modelled only warn). Base: pbd104@59; letnev (no Gravity Drive) gets a carrier (move 1) at 314, far from 205, and activates 205: moving the carrier there is refused; the cruiser at 203 (move 2, 2 away) still moves.
